'''Ryca Narwe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was employed by [[Eyar Treatment Systems]] as a third-class maintenance [[Technician/Legends|technician]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked in the [[Eyar City Sewer]].<ref name="HS" />

==Personality and traits==
Narwe was under-motivated by his job and would spend his time trying to do as little work as he could get away with. However, despite his laziness, he was a competent technician. Narwe was rude and crass, so his superiors didn't assign him any partners.<ref name="HS" />
